MEASURE — 072730Z paired opening trial, completed. Eight extra-independent random plies and ten were compared on exactly the same new eight-ply prefixes. With ten random plies, the share of openings whose first emitted score was at least 300 cp in magnitude increased by 6.80 percentage points [5.60,8.02] across the 4057 starts having a first score in both arms. This failed the preregistered equivalence margin of ±3 points. Raw rows/engine CPU-second ratio was 0.9918 [0.9855,0.9981], inside its separate ±5% margin; rows/node ratio was 0.9955 [0.9919,0.9989]. Do not treat the roughly 30-fold drop in opening-key repetition at 130.96M draws (072650Z) as a distribution-preserving replacement for today's 8-ply openings. No live opening-policy change. This is a failed equivalence screen and not a training strength result.

Full arms: 4096 eight-ply games, 4095 ten-ply games; one prefix had no legal continuation through the two extra plies and stayed in the ledger as missing. 21 vs 26 emitted no rows. Eight-ply first emitted scores: mean +119.23 cp from White, median |score| 80, |score|≥300 in 15.63%, ≥600 in 5.18%. Ten-ply: +149.89 cp, 107, 22.51%, 8.23%. Raw W/D/L for White, before PC after-game adjudication, 1826/1479/791 versus 2039/1235/821. Raw positions 526232 vs 501931; nodes 2062877796 vs 1976601850; child CPU seconds 812.51 vs 781.37. These are one local r67 producer's generated trajectories; real W5g verified-unique delivery costs still need their own pilot.

Reproduction: take the unmodified Board and move order of 072650Z with independent std::mt19937_64 seeds 202611230727 for the first eight plies and 202611230728 for the extension. For every attempted random ply, reject an already drawn position or empty legal list; same unsigned rejection sampling as 072650Z. Retain the first 4096 eight-ply prefixes, even if the extension terminates before ply ten. Manifest ID, tab, eight moves separated by spaces, tab, ten moves or empty, LF per record, SHA256 31f640c10359005a10fd365712d5cec3d4e5375e480e4930635236424e490e25. Use loop r67, 24 options, one thread and ucinewgame/isready before every arm; position startpos moves <prefix>, then selfgame softnodes 2000 evallimit 2000 maxply 300 writeminply 8 drawply 80 drawscore 5 drawcount 8. For 3 separate processes split by ID mod 3; shuffle each ascending ID list by Python Random(202611230729). On even IDs run 10 then 8, on odd IDs reverse. Read Linux child clock before and after full selfgame. CPU times depend on the machine. For uncertainty, NumPy default_rng(202611230727), 5000 samples of the 4095 paired IDs with replacement. For the CP comparison retain the rows with both first scores; for rates sum all rows and CPU or nodes of the sampled games before taking ratios. Per-arm threshold fractions above use that arm's available first scores; the reported difference uses the common paired set.

Raw CSV for all 8192 scheduled arm slots, SHA256 703ebea926ff829b8e0344bcdab7b73461962c8f7d70e08fc7ef6cfd86628889 (UTF-8, LF; White win/draw/loss = 1/0/-1). Recompute ending and missingness counts directly from it.
